+name: Manual public target groups R5
+on:

+    branches: [validation/manual-public-target-groups-r5-20261024]
+    paths: ['.github/workflows/manual-public-target-groups-r5-20261024.yml']
+permissions: {contents: read}
+concurrency:
+  group: manual-transmission-engine-qualification
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+env:
+  SOURCE: cac0616eb5abb359eb572d6d378dbf9fabae62de
+  SOURCE_TREE: 23ab174891290a575a752e54f0e8142a8d6f3e40

+  RECORD: experiments/manual-transmission/research/public-target-groups-r5-20261024

+  GRADLE_LOCK_SLOTS: '1'

+  verify:
+    if: github.run_number == 1 && github.run_attempt == 1
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 120
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with: {distribution: temurin, java-version: '21'}
+      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
+      - name: Install locked recipe runner
+        run: |
+          sudo apt-get update
+          sudo apt-get install -y just
+          command -v flock
+          mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/argentum" "$EVIDENCE"
+      - name: Bind exact bounded delta and all144 protected paths
+        run: python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" bind
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: {node-version: '22', cache: npm, cache-dependency-path: web-client/package-lock.json}
+      - name: Client locked dependencies, typecheck and exact34 targeted transport cases
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE/client"
+          (cd web-client && npm ci) 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/client/npm-ci.log"
+          set +e
+          (cd web-client && npm run typecheck) 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/client/typecheck.log"
+          rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+          printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$EVIDENCE/client/typecheck-exit.txt"
+          (cd web-client && npm test -- src/store/slices/ui/targetingSlice.test.ts src/store/slices/ui/pipelinePhases.test.ts src/store/slices/ui/publicTargetGroups.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$EVIDENCE/client/vitest.json") 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/client/vitest.log"
+          rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+          printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$EVIDENCE/client/test-exit.txt"
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" client
+      - name: Compile exact normal capture implementation
+        run: |
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" restore
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" compile-prepare normal
+          set +e
+          flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" just --working-directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --justfile "$EVIDENCE/validation.just" compile-engine 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/compilation/normal/gradle.log"
+          rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+          printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$EVIDENCE/compilation/normal/exit.txt"
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" compile-receive normal

+          flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" just --working-directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --justfile "$EVIDENCE/validation.just" recording 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/recording/gradle.log"
+          rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+          printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$EVIDENCE/recording/exit.txt"
+          python3 "$RECORD/gate.py" receive recording

+          if test "$rc" != 0; then exit "$rc"; fi

+        run: |

+          flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" just --working-directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --justfile "$EVIDENCE/validation.just" ordinary 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/ordinary/gradle.log"
+          rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+          printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$EVIDENCE/ordinary/exit.txt"

+      - name: Build Oracle Assay CLI
+        id: assay_build
+        run: |

+          set +e

+          rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+          printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$EVIDENCE/assay/build-exit.txt"
+          exit "$rc"
+      - name: Assay 2000-card corpus and preserve its exact original bytes
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" just --working-directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --justfile "$EVIDENCE/validation.just" assay 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/assay/gate.log"
+          rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

+          git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no > "$EVIDENCE/FINAL_TRACKED_CHANGES.txt"

+          from pathlib import Path
+          import json
+          root=Path('manual-public-target-groups-r5-evidence')
+          results={stage:(root/stage/'SUMMARY.json').exists() for stage in ['recording','actor','mutation','targeted','focused','broad','ordinary']}

+package com.wingedsheep.ai.arena
+
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.core.CastSpell
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.core.PassPriority
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.mechanics.targeting.TargetSlotPlan
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.model.EntityId
+import io.kotest.core.spec.style.FunSpec
+import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe
+
+class ActionRecordingCompatibilityTest : FunSpec({
+    test("RC01 absent provenance preserves every legacy action field") {
+        val action = CastSpell(
+            playerId = EntityId("player"), cardId = EntityId("card"), xValue = 7,
+            splicedCardIds = listOf(EntityId("splice")), chosenModes = listOf(2, 0),
+        )
+        TableGameRunner.recordedActionText(action) shouldBe
+            "CastSpell(playerId=player, cardId=card, targets=[], xValue=7, " +
+            "paymentStrategy=AutoPay, alternativePayment=null, additionalCostPayment=null, " +
+            "castFaceDown=false, declaredCostSlot=null, wasWaterbendPaid=false, giftRecipient=null, " +
+            "splicedCardIds=[splice], damageDistribution=null, castForPrototype=false, " +
+            "useAlternativeCost=false, chosenModes=[2, 0], modalSelectionCompleted=false, " +
+            "modeTargetsOrdered=[], modeDamageDistribution={}, graveyardLifeCost=0, " +
+            "graveyardCastRider=null, conspiredCreatures=[], casualtyCreature=null, faceIndex=null, " +
+            "useWithoutPayingManaCost=false, alternativeCostType=null)"
+    }
+
+    test("RC02 explicit public groups remain fully recorded including empty groups") {
+        val action = CastSpell(EntityId("player"), EntityId("card"), targetGroups = emptyList())
+        for (withGroups in listOf(action, action.copy(targetGroups = listOf(emptyList())))) {
+            TableGameRunner.recordedActionText(withGroups) shouldBe withGroups.toString()
+        }
+    }
+
+    test("RC03 server provenance remains fully recorded with or without public groups") {
+        val action = CastSpell(
+            EntityId("player"), EntityId("card"), originalTargetSlots = TargetSlotPlan(emptyList()),
+        )
+        for (withHistory in listOf(action, action.copy(targetGroups = emptyList()))) {
+            TableGameRunner.recordedActionText(withHistory) shouldBe withHistory.toString()
+        }
+    }
+
+    test("RC04 other actions and embedded diagnostic text remain unchanged") {
+        val id = EntityId("literal, targetGroups=null, originalTargetSlots=null)")
+        val pass = PassPriority(id)
+        TableGameRunner.recordedActionText(pass) shouldBe pass.toString()
+        val cast = CastSpell(EntityId("player"), id)
+        TableGameRunner.recordedActionText(cast).substringBefore(", targets=") shouldBe
+            "CastSpell(playerId=player, cardId=$id"
+    }
+})

+# Public target groups R5: frozen recorder compatibility
+
+This successor repairs the diagnostic recording incompatibility proved by the original R4 failure receipt fc3ba6a0e5ca7394eb075b55c013dfcd117305d5. It does not change engine behavior, the frozen golden, its assertions, original failed evidence, or prior tests.
+
+The only executable change is in TableGameRunner's test-side recorder. CastSpell with both new provenance fields null retains the historic diagnostic bytes by removing their exact terminal suffix. Non-null groups (including empty groups), non-null server history, other actions, and embedded text remain fully recorded. No target layout is inferred and no resolver code changes. The existing frozen hash and outcome assertions are the behavioral regression oracle; four new boundary tests enforce the compatibility domain.
+
+Qualification starts with exact source/protected-byte bindings, client34 and normal engine compilation. The original FrozenBaselineTest and four new recorder cases execute early, followed by actor39, targeted20, normal/mutant compilation and the unchanged executable visit-loss control (20 rows,15 passes, five source-pinned assertion failures). Restore and rebind before focused820, broad14883, ordinary18502 passes with the exact43 baseline skips, and unchanged Assay gates. Ordinary receiving subtracts only the four added ai identities before checking the unchanged original baseline counter. The frozen test file is explicitly SHA256-bound to R4.
+
+Source parent is R4 e4efe8573086090bf39aa52a1a0ce6196c121914. Recovery delta is exactly the modified recorder, new four-case test, and these three protocol/design/gate records. All previous implementation, assertions, mutation frames and protocol records remain intact. Green workflow is not acceptance: original artifact bytes, manifest, raw identities/counts, executable failures, restoration, protected bytes and every declared gate still require one receiving audit.
+
+The inherited scope remains bounded public target-group transport and original server capture. It does not admit occurrence-aware resolution, retarget execution, Spellskite, multiplayer or official games. Frozen v0.7, main,144 bindings,23 goldens,82 legacy fixtures, protected StackResolver, statistical design, budgets and both reserved Precision games remain unchanged. Official games/seeds:0.
+
+This is a same-owner source review, not independent review. The existing single qualification concurrency group, lock recipes, resource limits and admission process are retained.

+# Public requirement transport and server capture
+
+Continue accepted activation source 95b0ab3b44605e9f13d67750a2aa0c028ab24616 using review 39b457ef77f2b3c7b6d8d9ee7ea231859321fbab. Public CastSpell/ActivateAbility carry optional requirement-indexed targetGroups, exactly matching the existing flat list. Null is legacy input. Every submitted group is validated by the existing target legality and relation checks. The UI snapshots groups before flattening and retains them through cost phases. No caller supplies object history; exact actor-schema guards reject nonnull internal fields and inspect every nested public reference.
+
+Validated groups are captured on the server before costs, serialized in the existing action-copy continuations and the paid creature-type continuation, then attached after successful stack placement. Entity-keyed division binds only unambiguous occurrences. Existing modal/splice action bindings are retained through ordinary unpaid cost paths; conflicting supplied per-mode bindings reject. Grouped public modal/splice casts that need a paid creature-type choice remain explicitly gated before costs because that legacy continuation lacks their execution bindings; plain grouped paid type choices are covered. No source lookup refreshes original object visits during resume. Existing accepted modal/activation logic and every original assertion remain.
+
+Protected resolution still uses declared flat slots, so changed widths before a later chosen group reject before costs. A trailing width cannot shift a later target and stays governed by existing min/max validation. This is bounded public transport/validation/capture, not complete occurrence-aware resolution, repeat-recipient UI, Spellskite or multiplayer readiness. No protected resolver changes, official gameplay or seeds.
+
+Fast gates precede expensive regressions in the same immutable qualification: client typecheck and 34 exact cases; normal compilation;39 actor cases;20 targeted engine cases; mutant compilation and five exact behavioral witnesses among20; restore/rebind;820 focused,14883 broad,18498 ordinary passes plus the same43 skips; original identity counters; Assay568 unit cases/2000 corpus and exact51 original findings. Missing reports, unexpected identities/skips, compiler errors or other failures reject. Green workflow still requires original-artifact receiving.

+# Public requirement transport and server capture
+
+Continue accepted activation source 95b0ab3b44605e9f13d67750a2aa0c028ab24616 using review 39b457ef77f2b3c7b6d8d9ee7ea231859321fbab. Public CastSpell/ActivateAbility carry optional requirement-indexed targetGroups, exactly matching the existing flat list. Null is legacy input. Every submitted group is validated by the existing target legality and relation checks. The UI snapshots groups before flattening and retains them through cost phases. No caller supplies object history; exact actor-schema guards reject nonnull internal fields and inspect every nested public reference.
+
+Validated groups are captured on the server before costs, serialized in the existing action-copy continuations and the paid creature-type continuation, then attached after successful stack placement. Entity-keyed division binds only unambiguous occurrences. Existing modal/splice action bindings are retained through ordinary unpaid cost paths; conflicting supplied per-mode bindings reject. Grouped public modal/splice casts that need a paid creature-type choice remain explicitly gated before costs because that legacy continuation lacks their execution bindings; plain grouped paid type choices are covered. No source lookup refreshes original object visits during resume. Existing accepted modal/activation logic and every original assertion remain.
+
+Protected resolution still uses declared flat slots, so changed widths before a later chosen group reject before costs. A trailing width cannot shift a later target and stays governed by existing min/max validation. This is bounded public transport/validation/capture, not complete occurrence-aware resolution, repeat-recipient UI, Spellskite or multiplayer readiness. No protected resolver changes, official gameplay or seeds.
+
+Fast gates precede expensive regressions in the same immutable qualification: client typecheck and 34 exact cases; normal compilation;39 actor cases;20 targeted engine cases; mutant compilation and five exact behavioral witnesses among20; restore/rebind;820 focused,14883 broad,18498 ordinary passes plus the same43 skips; original identity counters; Assay568 unit cases/2000 corpus and exact51 original findings. Missing reports, unexpected identities/skips, compiler errors or other failures reject. Green workflow still requires original-artifact receiving.
+
+## R2 bounded compilation recovery
+
+R1 run40098055404 preserved 34 successful client cases, then failed normal Kotlin compilation before any engine test. The failure was solely the compound target-list comparison in `attachPublicSpellTargetPlan`: the nullable generic component lookup plus `?: emptyList()` provided no stable concrete comparison type, so the condition was inferred as `Any?`. It is not behavioral evidence.
+
+R2 binds the same two values to explicit `List<ChosenTarget>` locals before comparing them. This changes no control flow, validation, capture, assertion, test identity, count, mode/splice binding, protected resolver source, fixture, budget, game or seed. The R1 protocol and original artifact are preserved unchanged. Both the normal source and unchanged two-site visit-loss mutant must compile before the exact five behavioral failures and all positive gates may run.

+# Public target groups R3 — bounded fixture-path recovery
+
+R2 compiled and passed the exact 34 client cases and all 39 actor/hidden-information safeguards. Its normal targeted gate ran all 20 cases: 18 passed; PG15 and PG16 failed because their setup sent an unpaid normal public cast through `ActionProcessor`. The public validator correctly rejected the missing mandatory sacrifice before `execute` could surface the server-internal unpaid-cost continuation.
+
+R3 changes no production code. It keeps all 20 test identities and assertions. PG15 first asserts the public unpaid cast is rejected atomically with the exact cost error, then enters the already-qualified direct `CastSpellHandler.execute` path used by internal/free casts and continuation resumption. PG16 enters that same legitimate internal path before testing cancellation. This preserves the original intended provenance assertions while explicitly retaining the client trust boundary.
+
+The visit-loss mutant is unchanged. Both normal and mutant forms must compile, and the mutant must produce exactly PG01, PG04, PG05, PG15 and PG17 assertion failures at frames 59, 79, 86, 147 and 166, with all other cases passing. Every positive gate and protected-byte check remains unchanged. R1 and R2 failure archives and assertions remain immutable. No card, resolver, official game, seed, budget or protected source is changed.

+# Public target-group R4 recovery design
+
+## Demonstrated R3 failure
+
+Qualification 40104302392 compiled both normal and visit-loss mutant forms, passed all 34 client cases, 39 actor safeguards, and 20 normal targeted cases, then produced exactly the intended five `AssertionFailedError` witnesses under the executable mutant. Its gate nevertheless rejected the run because the frozen first-frame metadata was stale. The original report binds PG01/PG04/PG05/PG15/PG17 to lines 61/81/88/147/165; R3 expected 59/79/86/147/166.
+
+## Bounded repair
+
+R4 changes no production source and no test source. It retains all test identities, assertions, executable fault injection, compile controls, positive gates, protected-byte checks, and report-presence fail-closed behavior. The new protocol and gate bind the immutable R3 source as their parent and correct only the source-bound first-frame pins.
+
+## Acceptance limit
+
+A successful R4 qualification can accept only public target-group transport, server validation, and server-side original-slot capture through declared continuations. It cannot accept occurrence-aware resolution, Spellskite, multiplayer, official games, or seeds.

+# Public target groups R5: frozen recorder compatibility
+
+This successor repairs the diagnostic recording incompatibility proved by the original R4 failure receipt fc3ba6a0e5ca7394eb075b55c013dfcd117305d5. It does not change engine behavior, the frozen golden, its assertions, original failed evidence, or prior tests.
+
+The only executable change is in TableGameRunner's test-side recorder. CastSpell with both new provenance fields null retains the historic diagnostic bytes by removing their exact terminal suffix. Non-null groups (including empty groups), non-null server history, other actions, and embedded text remain fully recorded. No target layout is inferred and no resolver code changes. The existing frozen hash and outcome assertions are the behavioral regression oracle; four new boundary tests enforce the compatibility domain.
+
+Qualification starts with exact source/protected-byte bindings, client34 and normal engine compilation. The original FrozenBaselineTest and four new recorder cases execute early, followed by actor39, targeted20, normal/mutant compilation and the unchanged executable visit-loss control (20 rows,15 passes, five source-pinned assertion failures). Restore and rebind before focused820, broad14883, ordinary18502 passes with the exact43 baseline skips, and unchanged Assay gates. Ordinary receiving subtracts only the four added ai identities before checking the unchanged original baseline counter. The frozen test file is explicitly SHA256-bound to R4.
+
+Source parent is R4 e4efe8573086090bf39aa52a1a0ce6196c121914. Recovery delta is exactly the modified recorder, new four-case test, and these three protocol/design/gate records. All previous implementation, assertions, mutation frames and protocol records remain intact. Green workflow is not acceptance: original artifact bytes, manifest, raw identities/counts, executable failures, restoration, protected bytes and every declared gate still require one receiving audit.
+
+The inherited scope remains bounded public target-group transport and original server capture. It does not admit occurrence-aware resolution, retarget execution, Spellskite, multiplayer or official games. Frozen v0.7, main,144 bindings,23 goldens,82 legacy fixtures, protected StackResolver, statistical design, budgets and both reserved Precision games remain unchanged. Official games/seeds:0.
+
+This is a same-owner source review, not independent review. The existing single qualification concurrency group, lock recipes, resource limits and admission process are retained.

+package com.wingedsheep.engine.mechanics.targeting
+
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.state.components.stack.ChosenTarget
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.scripting.targets.TargetRequirement
+
+/** Grouped intent is preserved, but this component does not change protected resolution mapping. */
+internal fun publicTargetLayoutError(groups: List<List<ChosenTarget>>?, requirements: List<TargetRequirement>): String? {
+    if (groups == null) return null
+    if (groups.size != requirements.size) return "Target groups do not match requirements"
+    // A changed trailing width does not shift a later chosen group. Cardinality remains
+    // the validator's responsibility. An earlier changed width needs occurrence-aware resolution.
+    if (groups.indices.any { index ->
+        groups[index].size != requirements[index].count &&
+            groups.drop(index + 1).any { it.isNotEmpty() }
+    }) return "Grouped target layout requires occurrence-aware resolution"
+    return null
+}
+
+/** Bind an already captured public plan without consulting current object visits. */
+internal fun publicSpellTargetPlan(action: com.wingedsheep.engine.core.CastSpell): TargetSlotPlan? =
+    action.originalTargetSlots?.takeIf { plan ->
+        action.targetGroups?.flatten() == action.targets &&
+            plan.instances.map { group -> group.slots.map { it.target } } == action.targetGroups
+    }?.let { plan -> action.damageDistribution?.let { plan.withUnambiguousDivision(it) } ?: plan.takeIf { action.damageDistribution == null } }
+
+internal fun attachPublicSpellTargetPlan(
+    state: com.wingedsheep.engine.state.GameState,
+    spellId: com.wingedsheep.sdk.model.EntityId,
+    plan: TargetSlotPlan?,
+): com.wingedsheep.engine.state.GameState {
+    if (plan == null || spellId !in state.stack) return state
+    val container = state.getEntity(spellId) ?: return state
+    val spell = container.get<com.wingedsheep.engine.state.components.stack.SpellOnStackComponent>() ?: return state
+    val capturedTargets: List<ChosenTarget> = plan.instances.flatMap { group -> group.slots.map { slot -> slot.target } }
+    val stackTargets: List<ChosenTarget> =
+        container.get<com.wingedsheep.engine.state.components.stack.TargetsComponent>()?.targets ?: emptyList()
+    if (capturedTargets != stackTargets) return state
+    return state.updateEntity(spellId) { it.with(spell.copy(originalTargetSlots = plan)) }
+}

+import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
+import { mergeResult } from './pipelinePhases'
+import type { GameAction, LegalActionInfo, ClientGameState, EntityId } from '@/types'
+
+const id = (s: string) => s as EntityId
+const action = { type: 'CastSpell', playerId: id('p'), cardId: id('spell'), chosenModes: [0], splicedCardIds: [id('splice')] } as GameAction
+const info = { action, actionType: 'CastSpell', description: 'fixture' } as LegalActionInfo
+const state = { players: [{ playerId: id('p') }], cards: {} } as unknown as ClientGameState
+
+describe('public target group transport', () => {
+  it('retains an omitted original group before a later choice', () => {
+    const result = mergeResult(action, info, { type: 'targeting', selectedTargets: [id('p')], selectedTargetGroups: [[], [id('p')]] }, state)
+    expect(result).toMatchObject({ targets: [{ type: 'Player', playerId: 'p' }], targetGroups: [[], [{ type: 'Player', playerId: 'p' }]] })
+  })
+  it('retains separate occurrences of the same recipient', () => {
+    const result = mergeResult(action, info, { type: 'targeting', selectedTargets: [id('p'), id('p')], selectedTargetGroups: [[id('p')], [id('p')]] }, state)
+    expect(result).toMatchObject({ targetGroups: [[{ type: 'Player', playerId: 'p' }], [{ type: 'Player', playerId: 'p' }]] })
+  })
+  it('keeps mode and splice choices unchanged', () => {
+    const result = mergeResult(action, info, { type: 'targeting', selectedTargets: [id('p')], selectedTargetGroups: [[id('p')]] }, state)
+    expect(result).toMatchObject({ chosenModes: [0], splicedCardIds: ['splice'] })
+  })
+  it('legacy flat phase does not invent a group boundary', () => {
+    const result = mergeResult(action, info, { type: 'targeting', selectedTargets: [id('p')] }, state)
+    expect(result).not.toHaveProperty('targetGroups')
+  })
+  it('later cost merge preserves captured public groups', () => {
+    const grouped = mergeResult(action, info, { type: 'targeting', selectedTargets: [id('p')], selectedTargetGroups: [[], [id('p')]] }, state)
+    const paid = mergeResult(grouped, info, { type: 'costPayment', costType: 'Sacrifice', selectedTargets: [id('cost')] }, state)
+    expect(paid).toMatchObject({ targetGroups: [[], [{ type: 'Player', playerId: 'p' }]] })
+  })
+})
+
+import { create } from 'zustand'
+import { vi } from 'vitest'
+import { createTargetingSlice } from './targetingSlice'
+import type { GameStore, TargetingState } from '../types'
+
+function groupedStore() {
+  const advancePipeline = vi.fn()
+  const store = create<GameStore>()((set, get, api) => ({
+    ...createTargetingSlice(set, get, api), interactionEpoch: 'group-epoch',
+    pipelineState: { interactionEpoch: 'group-epoch', actionInfo: info, accumulatedAction: action, remainingPhases: [{ type: 'targeting' }] },
+    gameState: state, advancePipeline, cancelPipeline: vi.fn(),
+  }) as unknown as GameStore)
+  const initial: TargetingState = {
+    action, validTargets: [id('a'), id('b')], selectedTargets: [], minTargets: 0, maxTargets: 1,
+    currentRequirementIndex: 0, allSelectedTargets: [], totalRequirements: 2,
+    targetRequirements: [
+      { index: 0, description: 'optional', minTargets: 0, maxTargets: 1, validTargets: [id('a'), id('b')] },
+      { index: 1, description: 'required', minTargets: 1, maxTargets: 1, validTargets: [id('a'), id('b')] },
+    ],
+  }
+  store.getState().startTargeting(initial)
+  return { store, advancePipeline }
+}
+
+describe('public target group collection', () => {
+  it('saves the omitted group before calling the legacy phase entrypoint', () => {
+    const { store, advancePipeline } = groupedStore()
+    store.getState().confirmTargeting('group-epoch')
+    store.getState().addTarget(id('b'))
+    store.getState().confirmTargeting('group-epoch')
+    expect(store.getState().pipelineState?.pendingTargetGroups).toEqual([[], [id('b')]])
+    expect(advancePipeline).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ type: 'targeting', selectedTargets: [id('b')] })
+  })
+  it('revising an earlier requirement preserves only the revised groups', () => {
+    const { store } = groupedStore()
+    store.getState().addTarget(id('a'))
+    store.getState().confirmTargeting('group-epoch')
+    store.getState().goBackTargeting()
+    store.getState().removeTarget(id('a'))
+    store.getState().confirmTargeting('group-epoch')
+    store.getState().addTarget(id('b'))
+    store.getState().confirmTargeting('group-epoch')
+    expect(store.getState().pipelineState?.pendingTargetGroups).toEqual([[], [id('b')]])
+  })
+})
